en: Black‑and‑white view of a small European village in a valley with wooden and masonry houses, two prominent church buildings with steeples, and drying laundry in a fenced meadow in the foreground. Behind the village rises a steep, forested rocky hill crowned with the ruins of a medieval castle or fortress, including towers and curtain walls. The whole scene has a tranquil, rural character and appears on a single photographic card with no visible caption or printed text.
